title: 第三千九百零章恐怖的光球能量第三千八百九十九章白魔的狂暴攻势
content_zh:
就在白魔以为自己只要略微认真，就能够将这群蝼蚁般的修士给轰爆时，却发现这群蝼蚁们的反扑气势竟如此恐怖，身为王级超生命体的他，居然一时之间无法攻破这密不透风、固若金汤的神树世界，并且他还感受到了里面正在源源不断汇聚爆发的神力能量。
这让他不由懵逼，更是有些怀疑人生了，放眼曾经，也没有几个修士能够让他这位王级超生命体有这种感觉。
“该死，这群蝼蚁们的凝聚力怎会如此强大？居然比得上当年创世纪元的那群修士。”
“可恶！
！”
“给我爆！
！”
为了挽回自己的颜面以及身为王级超生命体的尊严，白魔身体倒退，随后，将身后的每一根手臂都高举起来，紧接着，掌心中的嘴巴喷出一股股白色能量，汇聚成一个巨大的圆形光球。
当这团光球出现之时，就连神祇空间里的麒凌风等人都感受到了致命的威胁。
仿佛整个宇宙世界已经没有了安全之地，只要让这团圆形光球爆炸，便足以毁灭一切。
“该死！
这家伙是打算将整个宇宙世界都给炸掉吗？”
“不愧是超生命体，居然比本盟主想象中的还要可怕。”
“苏阳这小子，他们是如何能够抵挡得住这位超生命体狂轰乱炸的？”
麒凌风忍不住惊呼出声，刚才那种级别的攻击，即便是他也难以抵挡啊。
天子则摇摇头道：“谁知道呢？不过这下子他们算是彻底激怒了这位恐怖的超生命体。”
“如此骇人的能量光球，一旦爆炸，足以摧毁整个宇宙。”
“就看苏阳这家伙所释放出来的神树世界能不能抵挡得住了。”
天琊圣主面露惊恐道：“那我们怎么办？我们会不会也受到影响？”
麒凌风语气平静道：“应该不会，毕竟有苏阳为我们吸收了绝大多数的能量之威，神祇世界，没那么轻易崩溃。”

“不过，我倒是越来越好奇这场战争的走向会如何了。”
此言一出，天子和天琊圣主不再言语，但他们看向眼前画面中的目光里，已然充满了恐惧。
白魔的身躯就像是永恒的梦魇般，在他们脑海里不断浮现，那恐怖的姿态、恶魔般的面孔，实在是令人难以忘记。
永恒神殿内，众多神祇见此一幕后，竟不由自主地站起身来，因为他们怎么都没想到，在面对王级超生命体的攻击之下，苏阳所率领的三大宇宙修士们竟能坚持这么久。
虽然绝大多数都依靠苏阳体内所释放出来的神树之干，但身为神祇，却能够感受得到神树世界中，一股股不断爆发喷涌的神力能量，而这些神力能量的来源，并非是苏阳一人，而是三大宇宙中的所有修士。
哪怕是先前苏阳等人血战黑暗主神时，都没有让这些神祇如此激动。
可现在却不一样了，毕竟王级超生命体的危险程度可是远高于黑暗主神之上，即便创世黑暗魔神还没有现身，但能够将这位王级超生命体逼到此等地步，简直超乎了众多神祇的想象之外。
在他们的想象里，刚才白魔的一番攻击，就足以让苏阳等三大宇宙世界的修士化为虚无了。
可现实并非如此，苏阳体内的神树不仅抵挡住了这一波骇人的攻击，甚至还能让三大宇宙的修士们依旧爆发出体内的神力能量予以反抗，如此团结一心，如此强大的凝聚力，足以让这群修士们对任何强大的势力造成威胁，哪怕是神祇族也不例外！
“这群蝼蚁竟能够将白魔逼到这种地步，实在是不可思议，这一招即便是我们神祇也难以抵挡啊。”
“是啊，想不到苏阳所率领的三大宇宙修士竟有此等恐怖的凝聚力，简直难以置信。”
“不过，这下他们肯定完蛋了，居然惹怒了这位王级超生命体，简直不知死活，还不如老老实实学黑暗主神一样，乖乖消失算了。”
“谁说不是呢？这般恐怖的能量光球，一旦爆发，足以摧毁任何生命了。”
“可惜了，这群不知死活的蝼蚁们，居然妄想抵挡王级超生命体的攻击，简直可笑。”
“虽然苏阳这群蝼蚁们的精神可嘉，但接下来也该结束这一切了。”
content_en:
Just when White Demon thought he could blast these ant-like monks with just a little seriousness, he discovered that the counterattack momentum of these ants was so terrifying. As a king-level super life form, he was unable to break through this airtight and impregnable world of the sacred tree for a while, and he also felt the divine energy that was continuously gathering and erupting inside.
This made him confused and even more doubtful about life. Looking at the past, there were not many monks who could make him, a king-level super life form, feel this way.
"Damn it, how can the cohesion of this group of ants be so strong? It's actually comparable to the group of monks in the Genesis Era."
"Damn it!
! "
"Explode for me!
! "
In order to save his face and his dignity as a king-level super life form, the White Demon backed up, then raised every arm behind him. Then, the mouth in his palm sprayed out streams of white energy, converging into a huge round ball of light.
When this ball of light appeared, even Qi Lingfeng and others in the god's space felt a fatal threat.
It seems that there is no safe place in the entire universe. Just letting this round ball of light explode will be enough to destroy everything.
"Damn it!
Is this guy planning to blow up the entire universe? "
"As expected of a super life form, it is actually more terrifying than the alliance leader imagined."
"Su Yang, how could they withstand this super life form's bombardment?"
Qi Lingfeng couldn't help but exclaimed. Even he could not resist the attack of that level just now.
The emperor shook his head and said: "Who knows? But now they have completely angered this terrifying super life form."
"Such a terrifying energy ball, once it explodes, is enough to destroy the entire universe."
"It depends on whether Su Yang can withstand the sacred tree world released by this guy."
Holy Lord Tianya looked horrified and said: "Then what should we do? Will we also be affected?"
Qi Lingfeng said calmly: "Probably not. After all, Su Yang has absorbed most of the energy for us, so the world of gods will not collapse so easily."
"However, I am becoming more and more curious about the direction of this war."
As soon as these words came out, the Emperor and Holy Lord Tianya stopped talking, but their eyes were filled with fear when they looked at the picture in front of them.
The white devil's body is like an eternal nightmare, constantly reappearing in their minds. The terrifying posture and demonic face are really unforgettable.
In the Eternal Temple, many gods stood up involuntarily after seeing this scene, because they never expected that the three cosmic monks led by Su Yang could persist for so long under the attack of the king-level super life form.
Although most of them rely on the trunk of the sacred tree released from Su Yang's body, as a god, he can feel the continuous bursts of divine energy in the world of the sacred tree. The source of these divine energies is not Su Yang alone, but all the monks in the three universes.
Even when Su Yang and others fought a bloody battle with the Lord of Darkness, these gods were not so excited.
But things are different now. After all, the danger level of the king-level super life form is much higher than that of the Lord of Darkness. Even though the Dark Demon God of Creation has not yet appeared, being able to push this king level super life form to such a point is simply beyond the imagination of many gods.
In their imagination, the white devil's attack just now was enough to turn Su Yang and other monks from the three major universes into nothingness.
But the reality is not like this. The sacred tree in Su Yang's body not only withstood this wave of terrifying attacks, but also allowed the monks from the three universes to still burst out the divine energy in their bodies to resist. Such unity and strong cohesion are enough for this group of monks to fight against any powerful attack.Forces pose a threat, even the gods are no exception!
"It's unbelievable that this swarm of ants can push the White Devil to this point. Even our gods can't resist this move."
"Yeah, I didn't expect that the three cosmic monks led by Su Yang could have such terrifying cohesion. It's simply unbelievable."
"However, they are definitely doomed now. They actually angered this king-level super life form. They simply don't know whether to live or die. They might as well just follow the example of the Lord of Darkness and disappear obediently."
"Who says it isn't? Such a terrifying energy ball, once it explodes, is enough to destroy any life."
"It's a pity that these ignorant ants actually try to resist the attack of a king-level super life form. It's simply ridiculous."
"Although the spirit of Su Yang's group of ants is commendable, it's time to end it all."
